# Gemma image-processor metadata fixture

`gemma4-processor-config.json` is the complete bounded `processor_config.json` metadata from `google/gemma-4-E4B-it` at `4ecc2ba63bcac23ba4a767fc87025b1450f84c9c` (1,689 bytes; SHA-256 `32bdf45d2ad4cc29a0822ddd157a182de76644f0419a6228d151495256e9813c`).

Source: https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-E4B-it/blob/4ecc2ba63bcac23ba4a767fc87025b1450f84c9c/processor_config.json

It contains no tensors, credentials or user data. The image-only adapter does not construct/use the included audio/video subprocessor settings. Full raw review output stays ignored under `validation-artifacts/pytorch-vision/`.
